ops.title: Provider backends: what the sprite and devbox CLIs cannot report, and the contract choices that follow
ops.body:
Observed facts that drove the internal/providers design (PR #4); none are visible in the code alone.

- Labels: neither backend round-trips key-value labels. Sprites stores only a string[] `labels` (omitted when empty; no label filter on GET /v1/sprites, per docs.fly.io/sprites/api). `devbox list -o json` carries no labels, purpose, or tags. So labels are a host-local record under <StateDir>/<kind>/machines/<id>.json; a machine created from another host lists unlabelled.
- Namespace run state: `devbox list -o json` has no status field, so Namespace machines report State "unknown"; Wake polls `ssh true` instead.
- Sprites API via the CLI: `sprite api -o <org> <path> -- -sS -w '\n%{http_code}'` exits 0 on 404 and prints its banner to stderr, so status comes from the trailing http_code line. List paginates with `max_results` (1-500) and `continuation_token` / `next_continuation_token`; status is cold|warm|running.
- Sprites has no stop verb; Suspend is an existence check and an idle sprite sleeps on its own.
- devbox: `nsc devbox` is a stub ("Devboxes are managed by the separate devbox CLI"); `devbox configure-ssh <name>` writes <name>.devbox.namespace.ssh plus .key under ~/.namespace/ssh with StrictHostKeyChecking no, trusting devbox-ssh-proxy.
- Image digests are the images lane's job (`devbox image describe`); providers pass a name as --image (Namespace keeps only the latest version) and a registry ref as --image_ref.
- Core owns profile -> size/image/region (Spec carries them); provider config holds only CLI, rates, timeouts, platform, and volume. Traits (tailnet mode, supervisor, host keys, credential helper) are machine facts on the Provider, per ccr-core.
